title: Receipt
description: Cryptographically signed, immutable Execution Trust Receipt proving the outcome of an Execution Trust Record at the time it was issued.

businessTransactionId.description: Business Transaction represented by this Receipt.

executionId.description: Execution represented by this Receipt. Absent when the Receipt represents the latest transaction state; every Receipt currently produced by ReceiptService omits this field.

trustRecordHash.description: Canonical hash of the Execution Trust Record, used for independent verification.

signature.description: Base64-encoded digital signature over the Receipt.

issuedAt.description: UTC timestamp when the Receipt was generated.
